text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait imports 42 million dinars ($138.6 million) worth of goods from the United States in October.
- Parliament speaker Ahmad al-Saadoun starts official visit to Qatar.

- Amman discusses fate of Jordanian prisoners in Kuwait with senior Kuwaiti officials, Jordanian minister says. About 30 Jordanians are serving jail terms in Kuwait for helping Iraqi troops during Baghdad's 1990-91 occupation of the Gulf state.
- Kuwait mulls selling its stake in Kuwait Public Transport Company under a three-year-old privatisation plan.
- Prisoners rape inmate at the Central Prison.
- Police find whisky and beer at the residence of Asian workers in al-Ahmadi. Alcoholic beverages are banned in Moslem conservative Kuwait.
